description: Declare a SharePoint document library as an observable external asset.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static / multi partition types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

create_observation_sensor.label: Create Observation Sensor
create_observation_sensor.description: Also create the polling sensor that keeps this external asset's health/data-version current -- same trio as the sql/s3/sftp/kafka ExternalXAsset siblings. When False (default), this component only declares the AssetSpec.

sensor_name.label: Sensor Name
sensor_name.description: Unique sensor name. Defaults to '{asset_key}__observation_sensor'. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between health checks. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key exposing `.observe(source) -> dict` (source is 'site_url/library_name') that returns `{'data_version': str, **metadata}`. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True; unset uses Microsoft Graph directly (requires tenant_id_env_var/client_id_env_var/client_secret_env_var).

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization

tenant_id_env_var.label: Tenant Id Env Var
tenant_id_env_var.description: Env var with Azure tenant ID. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True and resource_key is unset.

client_id_env_var.label: Client Id Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var with Azure app client ID. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True and resource_key is unset.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var with Azure app client secret. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True and resource_key is unset.

folder_path.label: Folder Path
folder_path.description: Optional subfolder path within the library to observe. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True and resource_key is unset.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

name: External SharePoint Library
